bio.heroTagline: Production AI, energy & fintech systems — built for Africa
bio.heroSubhead: I'm an AI systems engineer and founder building backend infrastructure for African markets — off-grid energy monitoring, multi-tenant payment rails, and applied-AI systems with real safety gates.
bio.shortBio: I'm Mahmud Madobi, an AI systems engineer and founder of Meertech Ltd in Abuja. I build production backends and applied-AI systems for the problems around me: keeping off-grid power running, moving money reliably, and putting useful AI in front of people who'd otherwise never touch it. I care about systems that survive contact with the real world.
bio.founderBio: Mahmud Madobi is the founder and CEO of Meertech Ltd, an Abuja-based engineering company building production software for energy access, fintech, and applied AI across African markets. He works at the systems layer: multi-tenant payment platforms with double-entry ledgers, off-grid energy monitoring and vending infrastructure, and autonomous AI-agent tooling. His portfolio spans renewable-energy ERP, utility-payment apps shipped to production, and government-scale agricultural intelligence — built fast with modern AI-assisted workflows, but engineered with the discipline of someone who has to keep them running. A computer science graduate with Huawei HCIA-AI certification and ALX Software Engineering training, he is part of a wave of African deep-tech founders building globally competitive infrastructure from the continent up.
bio.technicalBio: Mahmud Madobi (Sani Mahmud Madobi) is a backend and AI systems engineer building production infrastructure across a TypeScript-heavy, Postgres-centric stack (roughly 60% TypeScript, 26% Python across 90+ repositories). His work runs deep at the systems layer: a multi-tenant utility-payment platform on FastAPI and PostgreSQL with schema-per-tenant isolation and an atomic double-entry ledger that refuses unbalanced journals, fronted by an offline-first Expo/React Native app with transaction queueing and biometric auth (123 passing tests, production-deployed via Docker Compose). For a renewable-energy operator he led a Firebase-to-Supabase migration hardened by 66 sequential RLS migrations, 90+ deny-by-default policies, and 9 GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows with Cloud Run autoscaling and pgTAP gates. He has built fail-closed document-processing pipelines with MCP agent integration, autonomous on-chain agent wallets driven by an Anthropic Claude decision engine with hard safety gates, dual-provider solar-monitoring with HMAC-authenticated telemetry, and field-verification platforms with SHA-256 evidence integrity and append-only audit logs for a donor-funded electrification program. BSc Computer Science; ALX Software Engineering; Huawei HCIA-AI.
bio.oneLiner: AI systems engineer and founder of Meertech Ltd, building production AI, energy-access, and fintech infrastructure from Abuja, Nigeria.

narrative.engineeringPhilosophy: I build for the environments most software ignores: intermittent power, unreliable networks, and users who can't afford a system that loses their money or their data. That constraint shapes every decision. State lives locally first and reconciles when it can — SQLite queues with exponential backoff in Biz Track and RanaWallet, IndexedDB-to-cloud sync in ClearMind. Money paths are made un-replayable before they're made fast: double-entry ledgers that refuse unbalanced journals, idempotency keys, RPC-only wallet writes. Security is deny-by-default, not bolted on — RLS policies, fail-closed extraction, SSRF guards. I treat AI as a component inside a deterministic envelope, never the source of truth: hard safety gates validate every model decision after the fact. I ship fast with AI scaffolding, then earn altitude with migrations, tests, and CI gates.

researchInterests.title: Applied AI for Emerging Markets
researchInterests.blurb: Building AI systems for African contexts where the constraints are real: government-scale agricultural intelligence (Jigawa Agri-AI), CNN crop-disease detection for smallholder farmers (MaizeGuardAI), and Chartmetric-driven music-industry analytics delivered to a national statistics agency (NMAS). The interesting problems aren't the models — they're data sparsity, low-connectivity delivery, and making machine output auditable by domain experts who don't trust black boxes.

researchInterests.title: Energy-Access & Off-Grid Infrastructure
researchInterests.blurb: The largest cluster of my work: ERP and monitoring for mini-grid deployments (Offgrid Remote Portal, Mini-Grid Monitoring Platform), STS prepaid-token vending for Nigerian meters (PowerToken, ALOHA, RanaWallet), and direct Victron MQTT-to-Prometheus telemetry at the edge. I'm interested in the full stack of rural electrification — from hardware telemetry and provider integrations to the payment rails and field-verification workflows that make mini-grids financially viable.

researchInterests.title: Offline-First & Edge-Resilient Systems
researchInterests.blurb: Designing software that assumes the network will fail. Local-first SQLite with sync queues and exponential-backoff retry (Biz Track, RanaWallet), IndexedDB plus PWA service workers with last-write-wins reconciliation (ClearMind), and lean edge exporters that run on-device. The research question I keep returning to: how do you give a user strong correctness guarantees — no double-charges, no lost writes — on a connection that drops every few minutes?

researchInterests.title: Agentic AI with Hard Safety Envelopes
researchInterests.blurb: Autonomous and tool-using agents constrained by deterministic guardrails. Agentic Wallets pairs an Anthropic Claude decision engine with a rule-based FSM fallback and post-LLM safety gates (per-transaction caps, balance floors enforced after the model responds). Document Intelligence exposes an MCP connection registry with SSRF-guarded, encrypted-credential probes. The principle: the model proposes, deterministic code disposes — agents never get unchecked authority over money or irreversible actions.

researchInterests.title: Trustworthy & Secure-by-Construction Backends
researchInterests.blurb: Treating correctness, auditability, and least-privilege as architectural primitives. Deny-by-default Postgres RLS with SECURITY DEFINER helpers (ORP), append-only audit logs and SHA-256 evidence integrity (SalCollect, Document Intelligence), fail-closed extraction that never reports partial work as success, and double-entry ledgers that reject unbalanced journals. I'm drawn to systems where invalid states are unrepresentable rather than caught after the fact.

narrative.aiSafetyStatement: Safe and trustworthy AI is a working principle in how I build, not a research claim I'd inflate. When I put an LLM in a production path, I wrap it in a deterministic envelope: hard safety gates that validate model output after the fact (transaction caps and balance floors enforced post-decision in Agentic Wallets), rule-based fallbacks for when the API is unavailable, and structured-output schemas with graceful degradation when keys are unset. I keep AI out of the system of record — ledgers, RBAC, and audit trails stay deterministic and auditable. My interest is making model-driven systems honest: legible to the domain experts who rely on them, and incapable of unchecked irreversible action.

resumes.markdown:
# Mahmud Madobi
**Founder & CEO, Meertech Ltd — AI Systems & Infrastructure Engineer**

Abuja, Nigeria · [meertech.tech](https://meertech.tech) · [github.com/MEERTECHLTD](https://github.com/MEERTECHLTD) · [linkedin.com/in/mahmud-madobi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mahmud-madobi)

---

## Profile

Founder building production software for the parts of Africa where infrastructure is hardest: off-grid energy, fintech for the under-banked, and applied AI for agriculture and government. I am a hands-on technical founder — I architect and ship the systems, not just direct them. Across the portfolio that means multi-tenant backends with double-entry ledgers, offline-first mobile apps that work without connectivity, Postgres schemas hardened with row-level security and full audit trails, and CI/CD pipelines that deploy to production. The thesis is simple: globally-competitive engineering, built locally, for markets the rest of the industry overlooks.

---

## What Meertech Builds

**Energy & climate infrastructure** — the largest cluster of the portfolio.
- **Off-grid operations ERP** — Supabase/Postgres backend for renewable-energy and mini-grid operations: a multi-org schema across six Postgres schemas with deny-by-default row-level security (90+ policies), partitioned audit logging, an Express API on Cloud Run with JWKS-verified JWTs and Zod validation, and nine GitHub Actions workflows running schema migrations, pgTAP tests, and post-deploy RBAC verification gates. Executed a full production Firebase → Supabase migration, validated via live smoke tests against real accounts.
- **Utility-payment platform (RanaWallet)** — multi-tenant FastAPI backend with schema-per-tenant isolation and an atomic double-entry ledger that refuses to post unbalanced journals; offline-first Expo/React Native app with transaction queueing and biometric auth. Production-deployed on DigitalOcean across a 12-container Docker Compose stack with automated nightly backups; 123 passing unit/integration tests. Idempotent vend/fund endpoints prevent replay double-charges; pluggable provider abstraction for urban and rural electricity vending.
- **Mini-grid monitoring platform** — real-time dashboard for off-grid solar fleets, aggregating two telemetry providers (Victron VRM over MQTT, and a custom rate-limited HMAC-SHA256 HTTP client) into one React/Redux dashboard, with WebSocket push and a CI pipeline deploying to DigitalOcean via Nginx and PM2.
- Plus a token-vending UI for prepaid power meters, a Victron-to-Prometheus telemetry exporter, and engineering calculators for minigrid/storage sizing.

**Fintech & payments**
- **ALOHA Wallet** — prepaid-electricity vending and revenue collection: 30+ Postgres migrations hardening RLS, ledger foundations, and BVN encryption (pgcrypto); RPC-only wallet writes with the authenticated role revoked from direct updates; strict CSP/HSTS headers; webhook idempotency via unique constraints; integrated bank virtual-account and SMS flows.

# Mahmud Madobi
**Applied AI / R&D Engineer — AI Systems, Safety-Aware Design & Data Rigor**

Abuja, Nigeria · [github.com/MEERTECHLTD](https://github.com/MEERTECHLTD) · [linkedin.com/in/mahmud-madobi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mahmud-madobi) · [meertech.tech](https://meertech.tech)

> Applied-AI engineer and founder. My work is in production R&D, not academic publication — the focus below is on methods, system design, and the rigor that makes AI usable in high-stakes, low-infrastructure settings.

---

## Research & Engineering Interests

Reliable AI systems for resource-constrained, high-stakes environments: LLM decision-making with verifiable safety bounds, deterministic-vs-learned tradeoffs in decision systems, data lineage and auditability, and offline-first / intermittently-connected architectures. Applied across energy, agriculture, fintech, and government data.

---

## Methods & Findings (from shipped systems)

**Constraining LLM agents with post-hoc safety gates.**
In an autonomous on-chain agent system (Solana, public), I separated *reasoning* from *authority*: Anthropic Claude proposes actions via structured JSON with injected constraints, but a deterministic layer enforces hard limits (per-transaction cap, balance floor) **after** the model responds, so a hallucinated or adversarial decision cannot exceed the bound. A rule-based finite-state-machine fallback shares the identical interface, giving graceful degradation when the model is unavailable. Every action is event-sourced on-chain (Memo program) for an immutable, externally-verifiable audit trail.

**Deterministic decisions, conversational AI — separated on purpose.**
In a government-scale agricultural intelligence platform, the decisions that domain experts must audit (crop suitability across a 10-crop × soil/water/irrigation/tier matrix) are produced by a transparent weighted ruleset with per-decision reasoning — *not* an LLM — while Claude (primary) and Gemini (fallback) handle the conversational and advisory surface. This keeps the auditable core inspectable while still offering natural-language interaction, with provider routing for resilience.

**Fail-closed pipelines and provenance.**
A document-intelligence backend implements deterministic ingest → extract → validate → generate with **fail-closed** semantics: state transitions are committed before async work and partial results are never reported as success. Validation is a rule engine that normalizes extracted strings (dates, amounts, names) and matches them against trusted reference records, persisting findings with severity. An append-only Postgres audit trail with a canonicalized event format supports forensic review. Agent integrations are SSRF-guarded and use encrypted-at-rest credentials with rotation.

**Data lineage as a first-class object.**
A music-industry analytics platform built for a government economic-reporting mandate treats methodology and provenance as schema: a `MethodologyEntry` ledger documents every metric's definition, source, coverage limitations, fallback logic, and aggregation rule, *tied to each observation*; raw API payloads are stored with response SHA-256 hashes for reproducibility. A quarterly aggregation engine applies metric-specific rules (net-change, sum, last-value) to compute QoQ/YoY change over an auditable `ExtractionJob → JobRun → Observation` chain.

**Vision model in the loop.**
A maize-disease classifier (Keras Sequential CNN, 5-class, reported 95.35% accuracy) is served via FastAPI behind a React UI and paired with a Gemini assistant that turns predictions into actionable, farmer-readable guidance — a deployed example of model + LLM in a single applied workflow.

---

## Engineering Rigor (evidence in-repo)

- **Test discipline:** 50 pytest files covering the security surface of the document platform (auth, extraction, validation, RBAC, rate limiting, SSRF, virus scan); 123 passing tests across a multi-tenant fintech backend + mobile app; pgTAP database tests gated in CI; authorization shadow-testing before rollout.
- **Verifiable safety properties:** atomic double-entry ledger that refuses unbalanced journals; idempotency keys preventing replay double-charges; deny-by-default row-level security (90+ policies); JWT refresh rotation with a jti denylist.
- **Reproducibility & ops:** uv workspace with frozen lock file; digest-pinned Docker images; multi-stage CI/CD with post-deploy verification gates; structured logging (Pino/structlog) with request correlation IDs; Prometheus/Grafana observability.
- **Documented self-critique:** a dated security audit (prioritized findings triaged and remediated in-session, with deferred items tracked) lives in the off-grid ERP repo — methodology applied to one's own system.

---

**Backend / AI Engineer (Graduate Trainee)** — MIDS Dynamics Ltd · Aug 2024 – Feb 2025 — Backend APIs for AI applications (FastAPI, Django); ML models for predictive analytics; data preprocessing, feature engineering, and cloud deployment of models.
